reason: I buy in quantity to resell, and 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% on top eats my whole margin on clothes and phone cases. My cargo agent and the Shorja wholesalers already get me cheaper landed cost per piece, even if it takes longer.
objection: The landed cost per piece is too high for resale, and a refund only for damaged or wrong items does not help me if a whole batch is poor quality and I can't sell it.
would_change_my_mind: A bulk rate for shop owners: a lower buying fee on big 1688 orders and a cheaper per-kilo option by sea or land, with a quality check on the whole batch in the warehouse.
